items.definition:
a hole in a road surface, typically caused by erosion or traffic
The car hit a large pothole and got a flat tire.

a small edible fish
We packed like sardines in the crowded bus.

a child attending school
Every schoolchild should have access to quality education.

a blank book for sticking cuttings, drawings, or pictures in
She keeps all her old photos in a scrapbook.

a type of ray with a barbed tail
We saw a stingray swimming near the coral reef.

pain or distress
The war caused immense suffering to the population.

strong thread or string
He tied the package with a piece of twine.

paintings made with water-soluble pigments
She painted a beautiful landscape in watercolour.

a soft, round, flat-crowned hat
She wore a stylish red beret.

A piece of ground adjoining a church, often used for burials.
The old gravestones in the churchyard were covered in moss.

A cosmetic product used to mask dark circles, blemishes, and other small imperfections on the skin.
She applied concealer to hide the dark circles under her eyes.

A woman who is a member of a congress, especially the US Congress.
The congresswoman introduced a new bill on environmental protection.

A person who imitates or copies another's behavior, dress, or ideas.
Don't be a copycat; try to come up with your own ideas.

A soft, white substance formed when milk sours, used as food or to make cheese.
She made lemon curd for the tarts.

fire-fighting device
Every building should have a fire extinguisher.

a player who scores goals
He was the team's top goalscorer last season.

a female godparent
My godmother gave me a beautiful gift.

a live broadcast of an event over the internet
Thousands of people tuned in to watch the concert livestream.

the middle part of the week
The meeting is scheduled for midweek, probably on Wednesday.

a device consisting of a suction cup on a stick, used to clear blocked pipes
He used a plunger to clear the clogged sink.

a wheel with a grooved rim around which a rope or chain passes, used to change the direction or point of application of a force
They used a pulley system to lift the heavy box.

A building used as a school, especially a small, old one
The old schoolhouse stood empty for years.

The land along the sea
We spent the day walking along the seashore.

An item of underwear worn on the lower part of the body
He put on a clean underpant before getting dressed.

a fastener consisting of two strips of fabric
My shoes have velcro straps instead of laces.

the handrail of a staircase

a tiered stand for spectators, typically without individual seats
We sat in the bleachers to watch the baseball game.

a small lizard

an avocado-based dip

a telephone service providing help or information
If you need support, please call the national helpline.

a person from Kuwait, or relating to Kuwait

a shelf above a fireplace
She placed the clock on the mantel above the fireplace.

an unclear or indistinct utterance

a polygon with eight sides and eight angles

impoliteness
His rudeness was unacceptable.

a port, city, or town with a harbor for seagoing ships
London was once a major seaport.

a shaft or opening in a building in which a staircase is built
The fire alarm sounded, and everyone headed for the stairwell.

a device for adjusting pitch or frequency

the front window of a vehicle
The rain splattered against the car's windscreen.

a person who sells books

A female student at a coeducational college or university.

A large open space inside or in front of a public building, such as a railway station or airport, where crowds gather.

The condition of being unable to hear, or unable to hear well.

A type of board made from plaster pressed between two thick sheets of paper, used for making interior walls and ceilings.

A room with a toilet and washbasin; a toilet.

an expert on nutrition

a Vietnamese noodle soup
I love to eat a hot bowl of pho on a cold day.

a tool with two hinged arms and jaws for gripping and bending small objects

a Hindu worship ritual

the quality of being shy

clothes designed for sports or casual wear

a short, high-pitched sound

a restaurant specializing in steaks

a substance used to sweeten food or drink

a person or thing that throws

a dull, heavy sound

a person who welds

a machine-readable code

a structure where bees live

the state of being calm

the bone below the eye

coriander (leaves)

a board with a clip for holding papers

a person from Fiji
